reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown read the twentieth year as dated from the start of Jotham's reign rather than its length, since the historian had not yet introduced Ahaz by name.

discrepancy.note: Isaac Troki notes the numbers do not agree, since twenty years are ascribed to Jotham's reign yet elsewhere it lasted only sixteen.

quotes.text: while subsequently it is mentioned that the occupation of the throne only lasted sixteen years, so that the four additional years must be considered to belong to the reign of his son Ahaz.
quotes.attr: Isaac ben Abraham Troki (d. 1594), Faith Strengthened (Chizzuk Emunah), trans. Moses Mocatta (1851), p. 99, on 2 Kings 15:30 and 2 Kings 15:33.

sides.snippet: in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah
sides.verseText: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and struck him, and killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

sides.snippet: he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem
sides.verseText: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.
